info.name: Miku's Google Melody ?
info.description: Transform Google into a cheerful vocaloid wonderland! This Hatsune Miku-inspired theme brings cyan, pink, and white colors to your Google homepage, creating a cute and energetic atmosphere perfect for all Miku fans. Get ready to search with style!
info.additionalInfo:
This Google.com theme is inspired by Hatsune Miku’s cheerful, vocaloid energy!

Enjoy gradient backgrounds, glowing effects, and playful colors every time you search.

Made for all Miku fans who want a cuter web experience.

Updates may include new accent effects or images—stay tuned for more Miku magic!
